summary: Stocks are sliding mid-morning as the 10-year Treasury yield hit a fresh 24-year high, with the Dow down about 500 points. The spike in yields is pressuring growth stocks and consumer spending expectations.
market_note: Fed September meeting minutes land this afternoon, plus oil near $90 on Middle East supply fears.

items.why: Volatility spiked as stocks sold off on the 24-year high in 10-year yields; Dow futures dropped over 1%. Fear gauges rise when equity desks de-risk.
Slipped below $84,000 after Iran escalated attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, sending Brent above $101 and lifting yields and the dollar, per CoinDesk.
No single headline; moving with the broader tech tape as rising yields punish high-multiple AI names. Fraud-scam ad chatter around the stock is not helping.
Small caps lagging the broad market as higher rates bite; Goldman warned pressure from rising rates will drag on consumer spending.
